advisoryResults.title: New Carrollton Metro Rail Station Projects
advisoryResults.description: View potential impacts related to ongoing projects at New Carrollton Metro Rail Station. Metro and its developer are transforming the station into a first-class, multi-modal and mixed-use development.

advisoryResults.title: New Judiciary Square Entrance Stairs and Canopy
advisoryResults.description: In January 2023, Metro began a capital project to install a new stairway and canopy at Judiciary Square Station’s north entrance, located at F Street between 4th and 5th Streets NW.

advisoryResults.title: MDOT MTA Purple Line Construction: Silver Spring Station
advisoryResults.description: MDOT MTA Purple Line construction crews began work on the new mezzanine that will connect the future Purple Line Station to Metro, MARC, and the Paul S. Sarbanes Transit Center.

advisoryResults.title: Southern Ave Kiss & Ride Reconfiguration
advisoryResults.description: In June 2024, Metro began reconfiguring the Kiss & Ride Lot at Southern Ave Station and reopened the lower level of the Park & Ride Lot.

relatedStations.reservedParkingLocation: Directly to the right of the main entrance gate

advisoryResults.title: East Falls Church Bus Loop Expansion
advisoryResults.description: Beginning on or around Sept. 20, 2026, Arlington County will continue into the next phase of the bus loop expansion at East Falls Church station in close coordination with Metro.

advisoryResults.title: Bethesda Station South Mezzanine Construction
advisoryResults.description: Metro is building a new mezzanine at the south end of Bethesda Station to connect Metro Rail to the future Purple Line Bethesda Station. The mezzanine will not be accessible until the Purple Line opens in 2027.

relatedStations.reservedParkingLocation: Ground level rows GA, GB, GC, and GD
